SAVE_DESK_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many cards asked for in a minute
SAVE_DESK_RATE_LIMITED.meaning: One signed-in person may ask for a limited number of save-desk cards per minute (configs/agentic/save_desk.yaml, rate_limit_per_minute, 30 by default). The card is for one customer in front of one agent; looking customers up in a loop is how a copy of the customer list is made.
SAVE_DESK_RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait the number of seconds in the message and try again.

SAVE_DESK_NOT_IN_PILOT_ARM.title: You are not in the group given the card in this pilot
SAVE_DESK_NOT_IN_PILOT_ARM.meaning: While a randomised pilot is active (configs/agentic/save_desk_pilot.yaml, status active), only the staff drawn in advance to have the card are served one, so that the comparison with staff working as usual stays fair. The draw is not redone during the pilot.
SAVE_DESK_NOT_IN_PILOT_ARM.fix: If you think you should be in the card group, ask the pilot owner.

CLAIM_DIRECTION.title: A sentence said more than the numbers show
CLAIM_DIRECTION.meaning: The AI service wrote a comparison or a trend that the measured range does not support (for example, that one group did better when the range of the difference includes zero, or the opposite of what was measured). Every sentence of a drafted plan's summary is checked against the numbers before anyone sees it, so this sentence was dropped. More than one failed sentence replaces the whole summary with the one the product writes by rules.
CLAIM_DIRECTION.fix: Nothing to do. Read the plan's figures, which come straight from the product; draft again if you want a new summary.

CLAIM_LABEL.title: A sentence gave a result the wrong kind of evidence
CLAIM_LABEL.meaning: The AI service called a figure Causal, Estimated, Descriptive or Not proven when the product's own tool labelled it otherwise (only a randomised comparison is Causal). The sentence was dropped; more than one failed sentence replaces the summary with the one the product writes by rules.
CLAIM_LABEL.fix: Nothing to do. The label shown beside each figure is the product's own.

CLAIM_UNREFERENCED.title: A sentence pointed at something that is not there
CLAIM_UNREFERENCED.meaning: The AI service's sentence named a figure, a place in a figure or a proposal that the plan's evidence does not hold, so it could not be checked and was dropped. More than one failed sentence replaces the summary with the one the product writes by rules.
CLAIM_UNREFERENCED.fix: Nothing to do; draft again if you want a new summary.

CLAIM_FREE_TEXT.title: A sentence put a number or a verdict in its own words
CLAIM_FREE_TEXT.meaning: Every number in a plan's summary is filled in by the product from the evidence. This sentence's own words carried a number (also spelled out, such as 'twice' or 'a third'), a direction ('up', 'more', 'improve'), a cause or a certainty ('because', 'sure'), or failed the product's text checks, so it was dropped.
CLAIM_FREE_TEXT.fix: Nothing to do. The figures in the plan itself are the product's own.

CLAIM_MALFORMED.title: The AI service's summary could not be read
CLAIM_MALFORMED.meaning: The AI service did not answer in the structured form the planner asks for, so none of its sentences could be checked. The plan's summary is the one the product writes by rules from the same evidence, as it is when no AI service is connected.
CLAIM_MALFORMED.fix: Nothing to do. If it happens often, check the AI service connection on the Settings page.

PLANNER_NO_CANDIDATE.title: No campaign can be planned yet
PLANNER_NO_CANDIDATE.meaning: The planner found nothing it can draft: no finished scoring run of the use case without a campaign yet, no run that recorded how many customers were held back, no channel on which anyone may be contacted, a list judged not safe to roll out, a spend over the budget or one that cannot be checked against it, or a smallest effect given in points for an outcome measured as an amount. The message says which.
PLANNER_NO_CANDIDATE.fix: Do what the message names (for example score a new list, or set the channel's cost), then draft again.

PLANNER_NOTHING_TO_PLAN.title: This warning does not call for a new campaign
PLANNER_NOTHING_TO_PLAN.meaning: The warning card asks for waiting (an early look, a model not yet ready) or for a person's decision (drift, a campaign that did harm), not for a campaign the planner could draft. Nothing was drafted.
PLANNER_NOTHING_TO_PLAN.fix: Follow the warning's own next step on the Results page.

PLANNER_CARD_NOT_FOUND.title: That warning is no longer on the Results page
PLANNER_CARD_NOT_FOUND.meaning: The planner looks the warning up again on the server before drafting, and it is gone: the situation it described has changed since the page was drawn.
PLANNER_CARD_NOT_FOUND.fix: Reload the Results page and draft from a warning that is shown now.

PLANNER_NOT_FOUND.title: There is no such plan
PLANNER_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No drafted campaign plan has that id, or it was recorded in another workspace.
PLANNER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Open the plan again from its warning card, or draft a new one.

PLANNER_GOAL_UNPARSED.title: The goal in words could not be matched to the form
PLANNER_GOAL_UNPARSED.meaning: The goal you typed was read by the AI service, but it could not be matched to the form's own choices (a use case, an objective, a channel) or a number in it could not be read, so nothing was drafted.
PLANNER_GOAL_UNPARSED.fix: Fill in the form instead, or type the goal again naming the use case, the channel and any budget plainly.

COMPLIANCE_CONSENT.title: Not contactable on this channel
COMPLIANCE_CONSENT.meaning: The compliance gate did not send this customer on this channel. The run's own channel_contactability.parquet says they cannot be contacted on it: an opt-out, no valid consent in the ledger, an inquiry consent past its validity, or a legacy consent not registered with the operators. The customer goes on the next planned channel the gate allows, else is not treated.
COMPLIANCE_CONSENT.fix: Fix the consent record, or plan another channel.

COMPLIANCE_WHATSAPP_NO_OPT_IN.title: No opt-in record on this channel
COMPLIANCE_WHATSAPP_NO_OPT_IN.meaning: The channel is one of compliance.gate.opt_in_channels (WhatsApp by default). Such a channel needs a valid grant on that channel itself in the consent ledger. An all-channel grant is consent to be contacted, not an opt-in to the channel.
COMPLIANCE_WHATSAPP_NO_OPT_IN.fix: Import the customer's WhatsApp opt-in (a consent record with channel: whatsapp), or send on another channel.

COMPLIANCE_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH.title: Message is not the registered DLT template
COMPLIANCE_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH.meaning: The region requires a DLT template on this channel (for example SMS in India). The action's message_text is not its dlt_template_text with each {#var#}, {#numeric#}, {#alphanumeric#}, {#url#} or {#cbn#} slot filled by a value of that tag; a {#var#} value can be at most dlt_var_max_chars long, 30 by default.
COMPLIANCE_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the message or register the new text, then update the catalogue.

COMPLIANCE_URL_NOT_WHITELISTED.title: A link is not on the URL whitelist
COMPLIANCE_URL_NOT_WHITELISTED.meaning: A link in the action's message_text is not on the client's whitelist (configs/compliance/url_whitelist.yaml, else the region file's url_whitelist block) for this channel. A link is an http(s):// or www. link, or a bare host such as deals-x.in/a, in the text or filling a {#var#} slot.
COMPLIANCE_URL_NOT_WHITELISTED.fix: Add the host or prefix to the whitelist, or change the link. Text written with no space after a full stop (Dr.Smith) reads as a host: add the space.

COMPLIANCE_NO_CHANNEL.title: No planned channel to clear
COMPLIANCE_NO_CHANNEL.meaning: The contact has no planned channel at all: neither the action's catalogue channels nor the use case's configured channels name one, so the gate has nothing to allow it on.
COMPLIANCE_NO_CHANNEL.fix: Give the action channels in the catalogue, or configure actions.suppression.channels.

COMPLIANCE_CATALOGUE_CHANGED.title: Catalogue changed since the run
COMPLIANCE_CATALOGUE_CHANGED.meaning: configs/decide/catalogue.yaml is not the catalogue this scoring run ran under (catalogue_stamp.json), so no message can be tied to the run. The gate fails closed: every contact with a catalogue action is withheld.
COMPLIANCE_CATALOGUE_CHANGED.fix: Restore the catalogue the run used, or score again under the new one.

COMPLIANCE_SWITCH_MISPLACED.title: The compliance gate's switch is in the wrong file
COMPLIANCE_SWITCH_MISPLACED.meaning: configs/compliance/compliance.yaml sets compliance.gate.enabled, but that file holds only the gate's settings (the opt-in channels and the longest template value). The gate is turned on or off in configs/agentic/agentic.yaml, with Plan K's other switches. The setting is refused rather than ignored, so nobody believes they turned the gate on or off where it has no effect. No contact list is built until it is fixed.
COMPLIANCE_SWITCH_MISPLACED.fix: Remove enabled from configs/compliance/compliance.yaml and set compliance: gate: enabled in configs/agentic/agentic.yaml.

VARIANT_TEMPLATE_UNREGISTERED.title: An SMS variant's words are not registered
VARIANT_TEMPLATE_UNREGISTERED.meaning: A message variant can be tested on SMS only once its exact words are registered as a template. The variant has no action on sms in configs/decide/catalogue.yaml whose template_ref is the reference the message names (copy: followed by 16 characters) with a registered dlt_template_id (not empty, and not a placeholder such as <your DLT template id>).
VARIANT_TEMPLATE_UNREGISTERED.fix: Add an action on sms to configs/decide/catalogue.yaml, set its template_ref to the reference the message names and its dlt_template_id to the registered template id, then draw the variant arms again.

VARIANT_ACTION_MISSING.title: A variant is not in the action catalogue
VARIANT_ACTION_MISSING.meaning: Every variant tested as an arm has to be entered in the action catalogue before it is sent, and this one is not.
VARIANT_ACTION_MISSING.fix: Add an action on the variant's channel to configs/decide/catalogue.yaml, with template_ref set to the reference the message names. Then draw the variant arms again.

VARIANT_ARMS_NOT_MADE.title: No message variants were turned into arms
VARIANT_ARMS_NOT_MADE.meaning: Variant arms were not drawn, and the treat list stays as it was; no arm file is kept. The message gives the reason: the use case does not set generative.variant_arms to true; the run is not a finished scoring run with campaign copy; it chose among several offers; fewer than two variants are approved for every group and channel the copy was written for; or the treat list cannot say which template a variant customer gets, because the copy covers several channels and the list names no channel for that customer.
VARIANT_ARMS_NOT_MADE.fix: Fix the cause the message names and draw the arms again.

VARIANT_ARMS_NOT_ARBITRATED.title: A run testing message variants is not arbitrated
VARIANT_ARMS_NOT_ARBITRATED.meaning: This run is testing message variants as measured arms. Arbitration across use cases would drop which message each customer gets, so the run is refused here. Once the copy changes or generative.variant_arms is turned off, the arms are set aside and the run can be arbitrated again.
VARIANT_ARMS_NOT_ARBITRATED.fix: Send and measure that run's treat list on its own campaign, or arbitrate runs without variant arms.

MODEL_LICENCE_BLOCKED.title: This model cannot be used for commercial work
MODEL_LICENCE_BLOCKED.meaning: The model search you picked would load a model whose licence does not allow commercial use, or one nobody has reviewed for it (configs/agentic/model_licences.yaml lists those that are cleared). Nothing was trained.
MODEL_LICENCE_BLOCKED.fix: Choose Fast, Balanced or Exhaustive instead; they use only models cleared for commercial use. If you need the blocked model, ask the person who runs this system to review its licence and add it to the approved list first.

MCP_WORKSPACE_DENIED.title: That is outside your workspace
MCP_WORKSPACE_DENIED.meaning: On an MCP server for client data (mcp.workspace: clients in configs/agentic/mcp.yaml), each signed-in person belongs to exactly one client workspace, so every token they hold reaches that workspace's data and nothing else. The request was refused for one of these reasons: the person signed in belongs to no workspace; the run or campaign asked about belongs to another client; the id names nothing; or the request named another workspace. The answer is the same for 'not yours' and 'not there', and it never repeats the id, so the server reveals nothing about which ids exist.
MCP_WORKSPACE_DENIED.fix: Ask about your own client's runs and campaigns. If you should have access, ask an administrator to add your user id (GET /admin/users) to the members list of the right workspace under mcp.workspaces in configs/agentic/mcp.yaml. A person can be a member of one workspace only.

RECEIPT_MISMATCH.title: A receipt you kept is no longer in the ledger
RECEIPT_MISMATCH.meaning: Every MCP answer and every approval receipt names the ledger entry it was recorded under: the chain, the entry number, the entry's fingerprint and the fingerprint of the secret that decides who is held back. 'python -m engine.agentic.ledger verify --against receipts.json' looked up each receipt you kept and found at least one that the workspace's chain no longer holds as it was. The history was rewritten after the receipt was handed out. This is found even when whoever rewrote it recomputed every fingerprint and signature, which is why the plain check can still pass.
RECEIPT_MISMATCH.fix: Treat the ledger as tampered with. Keep your receipts file and the output (it names the first receipt that does not match), and raise it with the deployment's owner. Do not rely on decisions recorded after that point until the history has been explained.

MCP_TASK_NOT_FOUND.title: No such task for this session
MCP_TASK_NOT_FOUND.meaning: tasks/get, tasks/result or tasks/cancel named a task that this session did not start, that does not exist, or that has passed its keep time (mcp.tasks.ttl_seconds, an hour by default). A task answers only the session that started it. Another session, even the same person's, is told there is no such task, so task ids reveal nothing.
MCP_TASK_NOT_FOUND.fix: Ask with the same sign-in that started the task, before its keep time runs out. If it has expired, call the tool again to get a fresh task.

MCP_TASK_CANCELLED.title: The task was cancelled
MCP_TASK_CANCELLED.meaning: The long tool call running as a task (for example audit_campaign or get_proof_pack) was cancelled with tasks/cancel, so its result was thrown away when the work ended. The same code is also returned when a cancel arrives after the task had already finished; in that case the task keeps its result and its status.
MCP_TASK_CANCELLED.fix: Call the tool again if you still need the answer.

COMPLIANCE_VARIANT_NO_COPY.title: No approved words for this message variant on this channel
COMPLIANCE_VARIANT_NO_COPY.meaning: The customer was drawn into a message variant (a test of different wordings), and that variant has no approved template for their group on this channel. They cannot get their variant here, and the gate never sends a different message in its place. They go on the next planned channel where the variant has approved words that pass, or they are not sent. A campaign does not compare a variant whose customers were withheld for this.
COMPLIANCE_VARIANT_NO_COPY.fix: Write and approve the variant's copy for this channel and register its words in the catalogue, then draw the variant arms again. Or plan the use case only on channels the copy was written for.

COMPLIANCE_VARIANT_UNREGISTERED.title: Variant's words have no registered template to check against
COMPLIANCE_VARIANT_UNREGISTERED.meaning: A message variant's words cannot be checked on this channel, so they are not sent (fail closed). Either no catalogue action registers those exact words on the channel (its template_ref names them), or the channel's region rule requires a DLT template (for example SMS in India) and the variant's action has no dlt_template_text, or no real dlt_template_id. A campaign does not compare a variant whose customers were withheld for this.
COMPLIANCE_VARIANT_UNREGISTERED.fix: Add the variant's catalogue action for this channel with its registered DLT template id and template text, then draw the variant arms again.

actions.bands[*].min_score.meaning: Customers whose score is at or above this value go into this band and get its action. Raising it makes the band smaller and more certain.

actions.control_group_fraction.meaning: A random share of eligible customers is deliberately not contacted, so the campaign's real effect can be measured by comparing the two groups later.

actions.suppression.recently_contacted_d.meaning: Customers contacted within this many days are skipped, so nobody is contacted too often.

actions.suppression.suppress_opted_out.meaning: Customers who opted out of marketing are never put on a contact list.

actions.suppression.suppress_recently_co.meaning: Skip customers who were contacted recently (see the number of days).

evaluation.calibration.meaning: Adjusts scores so that a score of 0.3 means roughly a 30% chance. Leave the default unless advised otherwise.

evaluation.champion_min_improvement_pct.meaning: A new model replaces the one in use only if it is better by at least this much, so the model in use does not change for tiny gains.

evaluation.fairness_column.meaning: Optionally compare results across the groups of one column (for example region), to see whether the model works equally well for each.

evaluation.reasons_per_row.meaning: How many reasons are listed next to each customer's score.

evaluation.shap.meaning: Work out, for each customer, which of their details raised or lowered their score, so every score comes with its reasons.

evaluation.threshold.mode.meaning: How the cut-off between "flag" and "do not flag" is chosen. Automatic picks the cut-off that best balances catching cases against false alarms.

evaluation.threshold.value.meaning: The fixed cut-off used when the threshold is set manually.

features.auto_feature_engineering.meaning: Recorded with the run for a later release; it does not change results yet.

features.categorical_encoding.meaning: Recorded with the run for a later release; it does not change results yet.
